visible_goal: Analyze circular-shaft torsion Variant B; report the magnitude of final RP/pilot ROTY in radians and the solver-branch-defined shaft-solid maximum von Mises stress in MPa.
selection_reason: The physical model and result metrics are solver-neutral; native remote-point, coupling, and solid-element constructs may differ between Abaqus and ANSYS.

twist_angle.definition: Magnitude of final rotation about global Y at the unique free-end reference/pilot point
twist_angle.abaqus_extraction: abs(RP-1 UR2) in the final Step-Torque-B frame
twist_angle.ansys_extraction: abs(ROTY) at the unique (0,72,0) pilot in SET,LAST

max_stress.definition: Final-result shaft-solid maximum equivalent von Mises stress
max_stress.abaqus_extraction: maximum integration-point S.Mises over shaft solid elements
max_stress.ansys_extraction: maximum saved S,EQV,NAR over structural-solid corner nodes only

equivalent_modeling.abaqus: RP-1 plus kinematic coupling and Moment MY
equivalent_modeling.ansys: Unique six-DOF pilot at (0,72,0), complete free-face rigid/MPC coupling, and exactly one pilot-node MY=920 load
